_note: Local fixes applied on top of the upstream komhsgr M3U by update_live.py. 'replace' swaps an existing channel's URL with the first candidate that responds; 'add' appends a channel if a candidate responds and it is not already present. Candidates are probed on the GitHub Actions runner, so dead URLs are never written. Paste a known-good URL as the FIRST candidate to force it. Mega Cosmos and Antenna Pacific are Australian pay-TV (Foxtel/Optus ch 941) with no reliable free stream; leave a subscription URL here when you have one.
